d: Shiv Sena leaders created a controversy during a press conference by tearing pages from a book written by Sonia Gandhi. The incident has sparked a political debate, with the leaders demanding that the government impose a ban on the book. They expressed strong objections to its contents and accused it of being inappropriate and objectionable. Their dramatic protest has raised questions about freedom of expression, political intolerance, and the right to disagree with published material. What exactly is written in Sonia Gandhi’s book? Why are Shiv Sena leaders demanding a ban? Watch this…
